03b612b436df75ee49b2f4bbebcb4736.description:
Context
Zurich APAC is running a strategic initiative focused on reimagining how insurance is discovered, considered and sold in an AI-led world. To support that, Brand & Marketing functions are entering an agentic era where AI that doesn't just assist a task but runs parts of a workflow end-to-end: drafting and routing content, monitoring brand presence, orchestrating campaigns, surfacing insight, and adapting to how customers will discover and evaluate insurance in the future. We're looking for a Product Owner to help build the agentic AI stack for the brand and marketing function of the future.
This is a build role: turning a vision for AI-led brand & marketing into working tools that brand, content, and country marketing teams can use every day.
What the Role Does
Own the product roadmap for an agentic AI stack spanning brand & marketing workflows. Map the end-to-end brand & marketing function to identify where agentic AI creates real leverage
Identify and pilot agentic workflows that meaningfully change how the function operates – from content & creative, brand governance, campaign orchestration, performance marketing incl. SEO/ AEO / GEO, A/B testing, market and competitive intelligence, to performance & measurement.
Work hands-on with developers, marketing technology teams and external partners to scope, test and implement tools, not just advisory.
Design with human-in-the-loop workflows so agents make marketers faster without eroding brand judgment or quality control.
Help pilot new capabilities with specific country marketing teams before scaling regionally.
Manage internal and external relationships needed to support the stack.
Build internal capability and confidence around AI tools across APAC marketing teams, acting as a practitioner-advocate rather than a theorist
What We're Looking For
Must-Haves
5–8+ years in product management, martech, or marketing operations, with hands-on experience building or deploying relevant tools.
Broad fluency across the marketing function (brand, content, campaigns, comms, performance) - don't need deep expertise in every discipline, but understanding of how they connect well enough to sequence a roadmap.
Hands-on familiarity with AI tools relevant to marketing - not just awareness, but actual use and experimentation
Strong strategic instinct: can frame an ambiguous problem, develop a point of view, and communicate it credibly to senior stakeholders
Comfortable operating in a squad/project model - this is not a conventional marketing role with a fixed scope; it requires comfort with building the plane while flying it
Strong Differentiators
Experience in understanding the trust and regulatory dimensions that shape how the category behaves in AI environments
Has worked in or closely with a product or technology team - can speak both languages
Has built or contributed to agentic workflow implementations, not just evaluated them
What This Role Is Not
A traditional SEO or performance marketing role
A purely strategic advisory role - there is a clear expectation of hands-on delivery and implementation
A team leadership role at the outset, though that may evolve as the initiative scales
Location & Scope
Singapore, Hong Kong or Malaysia based, with a regional APAC remit.
matched_criteria: Company: ZURICH INSURANCE COMPANY LTD (SINGAPORE BRANCH)

Job Summary
As a member of the Finance team in Zurich Singapore, you will be part of the Planning & Performance Management (PPM) function, which plays a central role in business planning, performance analysis and management decision-making. The role provides an opportunity to gain an in-depth understanding of commercial insurance business lines, key performance drivers and the financial dynamics of the Singapore business.
PPM is at the core of breaking down the business performance, setting priorities and making strategic decisions. In this role, you will support planning, forecasting and analysis activities, provide insights on business performance, and work closely with internal stakeholders to help translate financial information into clear and useful business discussions.
This role is well suited for someone who is curious, analytical and keen to grow. It provides a strong foundation for broader finance and business roles over time, offering exposure to senior stakeholders, business planning cycles and cross-functional decision-making.
Your Role
Financial Planning and Analysis:
Collaborate with internal stakeholders such as Line of Business Heads in Underwriting, Cost Centre Owners, Actuaries and other business stakeholders to support the annual planning, forecasting and performance review cycles for the Singapore business unit. Analyse financial trends and business drivers to support meaningful planning discussions and decision-making.
Business Performance Insights: Support the PPM team in developing clear analysis and performance insights that help the business understand results, identify risks and opportunities, and make informed strategic decisions.
Business Process Optimization and Project Management: Identify opportunities to improve business processes and add value to the organization. Support initiatives and projects that contribute to improving the overall efficiency and quality of planning, forecasting and performance management processes.
Management Reporting: Support the preparation of timely and accurate management information for regular planning, forecasting and performance review exercises, with a focus on clarity, insight and usefulness for business stakeholders.
Communication: Act as a business partner to key internal stakeholders and respond to queries relating to financial information, trends and performance drivers. Work closely with other Finance teams such as Reserving Actuaries, Finance Operations, and Financial Accounting & Reporting to support high-quality analysis and business discussions.
Job Qualifications
· 2–4 years of experience in finance or a related function, preferably in the insurance sector.
· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.
· Organized and detail-oriented, with proven ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently as well as in a team.
· Experience with Microsoft Office, with strong Excel skills required; data analytics knowledge is an advantage.
· Knowledge of dashboard tools like Power BI/Tableau.
· Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
· A keen interest in finance, planning and business performance, with a passion for continuous learning.
· A desire to grow professionally, take on new challenges and build a broader career in finance or business.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Actuarial Analysis & Modelling
• Support the Head of Actuarial in the analysis, development, and maintenance of actuarial models for life, health, and investment-linked insurance products across APAC markets.
• Conduct experience studies and assumption reviews including mortality, morbidity, persistency, and expense analyses and summarise findings for internal and client stakeholders.
• Assist in product pricing exercises building and validating rate tables, benefit illustrations, and premium calculations for new and existing product lines.
• Prepare and review actuarial reserve calculations and liability valuations in support of IFRS 17, RBC, and other applicable regulatory frameworks.
• Build, test, and document actuarial models in Python or R,progressively moving away from spreadsheet-heavy approaches toward scalable, code-based workflows.
• Support the preparation of actuarial opinions, certification letters, and regulatory submissions in coordination with the Head of Actuarial.
Business Analysis &Requirements
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, product, engineering, client delivery, and finance to gather, analyse, and document actuarial and business requirements for platform features and client solutions.
• Translate actuarial and business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering and product teams can act on confidently.
• Conduct gap analyses between current actuarial workflows and desired future states, proposing data-driven process improvements and solution options.
• Support sprint planning, backlog grooming, and issue tracking in JIRA serving as the actuarial voice in agile delivery processes.
• Liaise with stakeholders across actuarial, finance, product, and technology to ensure alignment on requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
• Contribute to compliance and audit readiness throughwell-structured documentation of actuarial processes, data flows, and modelassumptions.
Data Analysis & Reporting
• Build and maintain advanced data models and financial analysis tools using Python, R, and Excel including dashboards, pivot analyses and scenario modelling for internal and client use.
• Monitor and analyse key actuarial and product performance metrics including claims experience, lapse rates, profitability indicators, and pricing adequacy generating insights to support strategic decision-making.
• Design and execute data validation and test cases using Postman and scripting tools to verify API outputs from 360F's actuarial and financial calculation engines.
• Extract, clean, and analyse insurance policy data from internal databases and client data feeds to support experience studies and adhoc analytical requests.
• Prepare clear, well-visualised actuarial reports and management summaries that communicate complex findings accessibly to non-actuarial stakeholders.
Client & Stakeholder Support
• Support the Head of Actuarial in client-facing engagements including workshops, product review sessions, and data analysis requests from insurance carrier and financial advisory clients.
• Assist clients in understanding actuarial outputs, model assumptions, and pricing rationale translating technical results into business-friendly language.
• Act as a point of contact for actuarial-related queries from internal teams including sales, client success, and product management.
• Contribute actuarial input to client needs analysis frameworks, benefit illustration tools, and financial wellness models embedded in 360F's platform.
Process Improvement &Innovation
• Identify opportunities to automate, streamline, or improve actuarial workflows from data ingestion and model execution to reporting and client delivery.
• Support the integration of AI and machine learning tools into actuarial processes including validation of ML-based pricing or claims models, and exploration of GenAI tools for actuarial report generation.
• Contribute to the development of 360F's internal actuarial knowledge base including model documentation, assumption registers, and process guides.
Stay current with actuarial developments relevant to APAC markets including IFRS 17 implementation updates, RBC changes, product innovation trends, and AI governance in insurance.
REQUIREMENTS
· Minimum 5 to 8years of relevant experience in actuarial, actuarial consulting, or closely related analytical role with clear exposure to life, health, or investment-linked insurance products.
· Pursuing or holding an actuarial designation (ASA, FSA, AIA, FIA, or equivalent) from a recognised professional body; candidates who are actively progressing through actuarial examinations are strongly encouraged to apply.
· Solid working knowledge of actuarial pricing, reserving, and product analysis across life, health, and/or investment-linked product lines in one or more APAC markets.
· Familiarity with IFRS 17 concepts and their practical implications for product design, liability measurement, and insurance financial reporting.
· Strong proficiency in Python or R for actuarial data analysis, model building, and automation with the ability and willingness to code models rather than rely solely on spreadsheets.
· Advanced Excel skills include complex formulas, pivot tables, scenario analysis, and dashboard design for actuarial and financial reporting.
· Experience with API testing and validation tools, particularly Postman, to support integration testing of actuarial and financial calculation services.
· Demonstrated business analysis capabilities including requirements gathering, user story writing, gap analysis, and agile delivery support using JIRA or equivalen tools.
· Strong analytical mindset with exceptional attention to detail, and the confidence to challenge assumptions and question data quality.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, able to produce clear, structured documentation and present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
· Comfortable working independently, managing multiple workstreams with minimal supervision while maintaining high standards of quality and responsiveness.
· Ability to work effectively in a multicultural, cross-functional team environment spanning multiple APAC markets.
· Bachelor's degree or above in Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Quantitative Finance, or a related field.
